fieldNotes.truckGate: Canopied multi-lane gate complex on the south access road (z20, 29.70546,-95.26809): a large white canopy spans the roadway with lane arrows painted on the approach and a separate small white building immediately east of the canopy.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Dedicated small flat-roof building beside the gate canopy - guard office. Could also house automated check-in; staffing not verifiable (no Street View on the private road).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approach striping shows ~4 lanes under the canopy (apparent 2-in / 2-out); counted from z20 overhead only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide canopy with 3+ total lanes and unused paved width on the approach.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Clear dock row on the south face of the dark-roof south section (~18-22 trailers backed in) plus docks on the west inner court; total estimated ~30. Inner-court detail partly obscured by canopies/equipment.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop operation: ~8 rows of trailers in the west yard (~70), a ~35-trailer row south of the building, more in the NW corner.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Long striped approach south of the canopy with room for several trucks before the gate; no marked stalls.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: South canopy gate is the truck gate; the NE drive off the La Porte Fwy frontage road serves the employee/visitor car lots.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single campus cluster: main plant plus a detached west warehouse and sheds; the container laydown further west appears to be a different business and was excluded.
